notes.title: Throbax TD update in calendar week 39 2018
notes.notes:
"The rumours of our death have been greatly exaggerated"

We are still here and present another patch to you

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
:Ughlar_big: On the home screen, create a button for buildings (enter building) so that it can be displayed when the player selects the building instead of right-clicking it. When pressed, the hero will move to that building. Done.
:Ughlar_big: Add the updates of the French translation. Done.
:Ughlar_big: Play the second tutorial automatically before the player enters the first level (single, multi or spectator-game alike). Done.
:Ughlar_big: There is an ambiguous upgrades-button on the victory screen. Merge it with the back-to-the-homelevel-button. Done.
:Ughlar_big: Draw a line when a tower is about to be built and it gets power, from the power-tower to the shooting tower. Make it a ground-effect. Done.
:Ughlar_big: Draw a line when a tower gets power. Make it a ground-effect that's visible when pressing SHIFT or when in build-mode. Done.
:Ughlar_big: The color of a to-be-built power tower's range-circle is red if powered and green if it doesn't get power. Change to grey. Done.
:Ughlar_big: Tweak effects for hero spells. Done.
:Ughlar_big: Update to new MonoGame version 3.7.0.1549. Done.
:Ughlar_big: Update to version 1.9.5.1. Done.
:Ughlar_big: Replace old intro with the corrected new one and place the old one in the cinema-building for nostalgic reasons. Done.

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
:Throbax_Bubble: When skipping waves, the value added to the skipped-wave-statistic is zero if the wave came before the 'last wave'-insert. Done.
:Throbax_Bubble: When loosing a level in MP the 'restart level' button is visible. Done.
:Throbax_Bubble: When encountering unexpected exceptions during resolution-switches, the game had a CTD. Fixed that by catching that and NOT saving or setting the new resolution in that case and by locking the graphicsdevice while switching resolutions. Done.
:Throbax_Bubble: In MP the game takes the stats of the current hero to determine radius of some of the meteorite effects, all of the nova effects instead of the hero that is currently casting them. Done.
:Throbax_Bubble: When on certain screen aspect ratios the research screen of the lightning tower and hero/spells doesn't display correctly any more. Done.
:Throbax_Bubble: When you're first or second, the leaderboard still highlights only the middle name of the five presented. Done.
:Throbax_Bubble: Level 48, 49 and 50 are still in dev-mode. Done.
:Throbax_Bubble: When a tower can be built on a tile and it doesn't get energy, it looks exactly like any other tower that's already built (tinting color bug). Done.
:Throbax_Bubble: The font that is used in the home level (building headings when selected) doesn't support special characters; Use other font that does. Done.
:Throbax_Bubble: The attack-preferences button where you can chose what enemy to aim for, is cut off right when playing in 800x600 windowed mode. Done.
:Throbax_Bubble: In the French translation the building names were gone completely. Done.

PS: If you encounter problems and want to report them please refert to this thread: http://steamcommunity.com/app/341570/discussions/0/496880503067139198/ 
PPS: Up to date list on know issues can be found at http://steamcommunity.com/app/341570/discussions/0/496880503067363362/

    [*] Let the hero-shot be adaptive like when we add an additional effect, the impact circle should show that.

notes.title: Throbax TD update in calendar week 3 - the week after M U L T I P L A Y E R went live!
notes.notes:
The week after multiplayer release was quite busy - so mainly bug-fixes:

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Pressing the '3' key freezes and crashes the game.
	[*] Obviously, sometimes the profile is vanishing after a restart. No debug-log entry is generated. Was an error when patching game-descriptors (happened the first time you started a game - the progress from this first session wasn't saved at all).
	[*] When selecting towers using a doubleclick (and possibliy when selecting monsters as well) the behavior is sometimes irradical. Sometimes it works, sometimes only a single tower gets selected. Problem was when multiple towers where selected using doubleclick then the GUI reacted on the first click, clearing the selection, and then reacting on the second click, reactivating it. That time was too short. Made an override.
	[*] The LevelCompletedMenuScreen is broken. It's so wide that it fades out-of-screen on the right side. Make the columns smaller.
	[*] When selecting multiple towers and waiting for money for upgrades (I was testing it in lvl6 with 8 wooden-towers around the source-power-tower) sometimes the upgrade-button doesn't become 'unghosted' aka activated, even if I have the necessary money for an upgrade.
	[*] When a wooden-tower gets built for the first time in a level or when a lightning-tower, ice-tower or poison-tower shoots for the first time, there is a lag for about half a second. It was because the sounds being loaded on demand. Pre-loaded them at game-start.
	[*] There seems to be a CTD in level 21 around wave 3 or 4 when building and using a microwave-tower. Was on every level and a bug in the hit-routine of the tower.
	[*] After casting a spell the build-animation is broken (rotating, too small sprite). RuneSprites were not pooled properly and returned as AnimatedIso8Sprites.
	[*] Some sound-cues are not updated in the right way (when the camera moves for example). They appear to stay at their initial volume. Bug in limit-queue rewrite.
[/list]

[b]Hi all![/b]

The first 10 days at Steam have been quite busy - we got feedback & bug-reports and adressed lots of the things immediately.

And we released 2 patches to solve problems found:

[*] Bugfix in options menu where slider could go in wrong direction
[*] Bugfix for tower-buttons which only refreshed when hero was selected
[*] Bugfix display bug where creeps 
[/list]

[list]
[*] Bugfix in calculation of achievement progress

Psilo, Wyzau and Mercury
